scope: Source-level receivers and review issues, not new mathematical proof or execution permit.

receivers.input_contract: Two labelled species, unit transfers, known controlled totals and one source/rate bank.
receivers.result: Exact panel fibre and scoped degree/positive-support finite certificates.
receivers.limit: Not arbitrary unreconstructed hidden networks or finite noisy trajectories.

receivers.input_contract: Exact stopped pair law at Δ and 2Δ, scalar ellipticity and declared holding protocol.
receivers.result: Same coefficient/fibre conclusion via killed-kernel extraction and scalar spectral identification.
receivers.limit: Not two unpaired marginals, two samples or an unmonitored free diffusion.

receivers.input_contract: Named catalytic, neutral or balanced family with specified starts, readout and stop.
receivers.result: Rate/hidden-start recovery, label ambiguity or hidden-rate invisibility at the stated family scope.
receivers.limit: Not all-rival unknown-network identifiability or a generic non-Markov criterion.

receivers.input_contract: Independent hidden chemical block and actual minimum-exit held observation.
receivers.result: Observation equality reduces to fixed-start hidden exit-survival equality.
receivers.limit: All finite hidden chemical response classification remains unsupplied.

receivers.input_contract: Literal initial-state quantifier versus generator equality over open sets.
receivers.result: Retained conserved-line checkpoint and separate weaker-reviewed cone/family deductions.
receivers.limit: Potential source issue, not established erratum, author decision or rejection of all-start generator results.
